1. Heard counsel for the applicant, Sri Sharad Saran Srivastava, counsel for the informant-opposite party no.2 and Sri V.P. Tripathi, learned A.G.A. for the State-opposite party.
2.

The instant bail application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. has been filed with the prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail in Case Crime No. 35 of 2024 under Section 376(2)n I.P.C. and Section 5L/6 POCSO Act, Police Station- Kadadham, District- Kaushambi, during the pendency of the trial.

3. Counsel for the applicant submits that earlier the applicant was granted bail under Sections 363,
366, 120B, 376, 506 I.P.C. and Sections 5/6 POCSO Act, Police Station- Kadadham, District- Jitendra Kumar Sonkar vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 14 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/186900272/

sentences.text: During the course of investigation, Sections 376(2)n and Section 5L/6 POCSO Act were added by the Investigating Officer.
The applicant seeks bail in the added sections.
He further submits that for the reasons stated in the order dated 07.08.2024, the applicant is entitled to be enlarged on bail in added sections as well.
4. Learned A.G.A. and counsel for the informant/opposite party no. 2 have opposed the prayer for bail but could not satisfactorily dispute the aforesaid facts from the record.

5. Having heard counsel for the parties and having perused the record this Court prima facie finds that earlier the applicant was granted bail under Sections 363, 366, 120B, 376, 506 I.P.C. and Sections 5/6 POCSO Act, vide order dated 07.08.2024 passed by this Court in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 25545 of 2024.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 25545 of 2024
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: The applicant has no criminal antecedents and has remained confined for almost four months and there is no hope of early conclusion of trial, more so when no reasonable apprehension has been brought to the fore by the State that the applicant, if enlarged on bail, would either tamper with the evidence or delay the trial or intimidate the witness, without commenting on merits of the case, I am of the opinion that the applicant is entitled to be enlarged on bail.
In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the prosecution shall be at liberty to move bail cancellation application before this Court.
